title: AX Notes (resumed): voice AI note-taker + to-do lists, AmberX speaks (lib-speech), overlay/triggers/ai/onboarding libs + 5 AI plugins
asked: Make AmberX speak and integrate AI for building notes and integrating with the codebase, voice control, multiple sorted note lists and to-do lists with notes, categorized. Use ActiveX code for triggers and screen overlay, read codebase. Profile refactor; Fable/Opus split; Opus switch approved early at 16:40; up to 5 agents.

steps.text: Opus: s6-s23 libraries, app, lists + to-dos, 5 plugins, codebase integration, demos
CI green (kernel, libs + tests, AX Notes + plugins, demos, web console)

result.summary: Built and CI green, but PR #136 was closed unmerged on Oct 28 2026 (Brett: "Kill 136"): the AmberX app already has its own notes, tasks, AI, dictation and voice plugins, so the separate AX Notes app, its 6 demo apps and the unused native libs (lib-overlay, lib-speech, lib-triggers, lib-ai, lib-onboarding) were dropped. Nothing reached main. Branch fable/ax-notes kept.
